food-ladob.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset: individual food card for a travel website. Create one polished culinary watercolor illustration, landscape 3:2, no text. Subject: Seychelles sweet ladob: ripe plantain banana and sweet potato pieces slowly simmered in creamy coconut milk with vanilla and nutmeg. A shallow cream ceramic bowl holds soft thick diagonal banana chunks and pale golden sweet potato pieces nestled in an ivory coconut sauce; a few tiny nutmeg specks and a single vanilla pod beside the bowl suggest the fragrance. This is a homely warm spoon dessert, not a gelatin pudding, smoothie, ice cream, or banana split. Three-quarter overhead close-up, gentle Indian Ocean daylight, muted leaf-green cloth and warm cream paper background, delicate hand-painted watercolor textures and appetizing recognizable ingredients. One bowl, minimal props, no text, labels, branding, watermark or collage. Clearly illustrated, not a restaurant photograph.
